note: This file declares requested desktop choices; it does not itself start a compositor. The live userspace must parse the Multiboot command line chm.desktop=aurora|marine, validate the installed session manifest, launch the selected session, and emit a real readiness marker. User-selectable default desktop candidates are aurora, marine, freexp and freewin11; this is still a session-selection contract, not proof of native compositor startup. The first selected candidate is the fallback; a user preference may select any listed desktop. Session launch remains prototype-only.

fallback.reason: desktop session missing, compositor startup failed, or readiness timeout
